rv.q: Deep-Heat Rivalry commits to its stupidity admirably and, beneath all the bare flesh and denigration of British and American icons, contains considerably more wit than its trashy exterior might suggest.
Deep-Heat Rivalry is a firecracker of an evening.
With winning vocals, irreverent humour and sultry choreography, this adults-only panto is a riotous night, with joy (and filth) at its core.
It’s camp, cheeky, filthy, wonderfully daft and incredibly entertaining.
Deep-Heat Rivalry is an unforgettable night of fun!

For all its occasional chaos, Deep-Heat Rivalry remains a joyous, camp, queer, relevant and gloriously silly musical revue and TV parody that leaves audiences gasping for breath, whether from laughter or shock.
It had the feeling of an undergraduate production wanting to be outrageous but lacking any original ideas.
A thoroughly entertaining and winningly silly night out.

cn.t: This raunchy musical parody of TV's Heated Rivalry wins over most critics with its outrageous humor, powerhouse vocals, and standout choreography, though those unfamiliar with the source material may find themselves lost in the innuendo-filled chaos.
